candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether TDS monitoring is established solely by basin/salinity-policy applicability affects the set of monitoring requirements evaluated as required for FY2025.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Which of the three salinity tests applies, and whether the one-ton-per-day or 366-tons-per-year threshold governs, changes both limit applicability and the monitoring framework tied to salt discharge.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the fresh water waiver applies determines if numeric salinity limits are enforceable (Purpose A), what TDS monitoring frequency is required (Purpose B), and how periods without salinity-limit comparisons are classified (Purpose C).

candidates.locator: page 11, section statement_of_basis, subsection d (Total Dissolved Solids)
candidates.exact_span: Furthermore, the reported TDS is less than 1 ton/day, monitoring shall continue to be performed once every three months, using grab sample.
